viv: TL;DR from the postmortem: recurring p99 spikes around 03:00 UTC tied to KV cold misses and overlapping checkpoint syncs. Need owners for metrics, alerts, SLO holding, and a canary drill.

viv: Action list:
- M1: KV miss-rate + TTL churn panels (owner, due)
- M2: Per-pod batch-size histogram + hot-node alert (owner, due)
- M3: Temporary SLO holding plan + customer advisory draft (owner, due)
- M4: Canary rollback runbook update + dry-run drill (owner, drill window)
- M5: Stagger checkpoint scheduling (owner, infra ETA)

omar: I'll grab M1. Plan: add 24h/7d heatmaps, sample tracer, low-card labels. ETA 2026-04-04.

pei: Taking M2. Will export histogram to Prom and add alert: p95 batch_size>75 sustained 10m -> page. ETA 2026-03-30.

rachel: M3 here. Propose p99 hold from 100ms -> 140ms for up to 10 days while mitigations deploy; will draft CR+advisory. Ops/legal signoff needed. Draft by 2026-03-25 EOD.

incident-bot: Ticket REDW-4298 created: "Postmortem follow-ups: KV metrics, batching, SLO holding, canary drill" https://redwood.internal/tickets/REDW-4298

ov: viv: For M4 I'll coordinate drill on Tue 03:00-03:45 UTC, owner viv, due 2026-03-29.

ov: pei: for M5 please open INFRA ticket for stagger; replay showed ~30% p99 improvement when checkpointing staggered.

viv: Summary: M1 omar (2026-04-04), M2 pei (2026-03-30), M3 rachel draft (2026-03-25), M4 viv drill (2026-03-29), M5 infra ticket pending. Check-in next 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC in #eng-sre. Update REDW-4298 if anything slips.
